items.t: Gaotu Techedu to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 25, 2026
items.sum: Gaotu Techedu Inc. (NYSE: GOTU) ("Gaotu" or the "Company"), a leading technology-driven education company in China focused on enabling lifelong learning through AI-powered solutions, today announced that it will report its financial results for the third quarter 2026 ended September 30, 2026, before U.S. markets open on Wednesday, November 25, 2026.
